verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents OpenRouter shipping an MCP *server* (docs-14/26/34) that lets other tools pull OpenRouter data — the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether OpenRouter itself can consume/plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. While OpenRouter advertises tool-calling standardization and 'building agents' (docs-5, docs-37), nothing in the pack shows OpenRouter acting as an MCP client able to connect to and use third-party MCP servers' tools.
